messages:
mike: Need a one-off SIEM export for incident triage on prod-cache-2. Potential data exfil pattern. Opening TKT-4890 for a scrubbed export + JIT decrypt.

	tara: Follow JIT-unlock runbook. Export rules: field-filtered, pseudonymize IDs, write encrypted to audit S3, unwrap only via kms-proxy after 2 approvers. Default unwrap window 48h, export retention 7d.

	ivan: Can exporter call KMS:Decrypt directly? We want to avoid granting that.

	tara: No direct Decrypt. Use exporter-wrapping-key for envelope encryption. KMS-proxy handles unwrap on approval and streams to ephemeral analysis VM. Proxy logs ticket, approvers, requester, and expiry.

	mike: What fields should be removed?

	ivan: Keep timestamp, host, src_ip, dst_ip, process, event_type, port. Drop emails, auth tokens, and SSNs. If stable IDs needed, use HMAC-based pseudonyms keyed to the ticket vault.

	audit-bot: TKT-4890 created by mike. Please add approvers and desired unwrap TTL. See internal runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/security/jit-unlock

	mike: Adding approvers @tara and @ivan, requesting 24h unwrap and bastion analysis. Query and host list added to ticket.

	tara: Approved. ivan: please confirm exporter will not have KMS:Decrypt and will apply scrub rules.

	ivan: Confirmed. Will wire exporter to write to s3://redwood-audit/exports/TKT-4890/ and call proxy on approval. Proxy unwrap expiry set to 3749170000 (24h). Security will run a post-export scrub validation.
